tools.name: search_esim_plans
tools.description: Search travel eSIM data plans for a destination and show them on the page. Returns each plan's plan_id, data allowance, validity and price. Call this before start_esim_checkout.

country.description: Destination country or region name, or its ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code — 'Japan' or 'JP'

tools.name: start_esim_checkout
tools.description: Start buying one of the eSIM plans currently shown on the page. Creates an unpaid order and sends the browser to a hosted Stripe checkout page for the customer to pay on. Nothing is charged until they enter their own card details there.
